verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents a dedicated test-account environment with public signup and per-scenario testing guides: payments, test cards, disputes, fraud, payouts and AVS. For AI-native workflows, its MCP server publishes a separate sandbox endpoint (checkout.mcp.sbox.cko.tech) distinct from production (mcp.checkout.com), so an agent can be pointed at sandbox only. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that sandbox data is isolated from production, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox MCP flow.
